budget.failed_or_timed_out_runs: report as failed/censored; do not silently raise budget, pick best seed or add candidates

code_state: uncommitted additions; registration lock hashes this preflight code; future trainer code needs a run manifest before fit

architecture.conv_variant: parallel Conv1D on embeddings, 128 channels, kernel=3, stride=1, padding=1, ReLU, masked global max; concatenate with GRU pooling
architecture.heads: linear 8 aspect logits + 7 x 3 sentiment logits
architecture.pooling: masked max + masked mean over bidirectional GRU states

loss.aspect: BCEWithLogitsLoss mean over all review x 8 aspect cells
loss.sentiment: CrossEntropy over gold-present core aspect cells only; sum / number of such cells in batch; zero if none

segmentation.bridge: src/VnCoreNLPBatch.java; join segmented sentences by one space; each review independent

preprocessing.vocabulary: train token frequency descending, Unicode lexical ascending ties; PAD=0, UNK=1; max 30000 including specials; min_freq=1

heads.output: linear 8 aspect logits + 7 x 3 sentiment logits

initialization.weight_download: only at training launch, never main/latest; pretrained weights have not been downloaded in preflight

loss.aspect: BCEWithLogitsLoss mean over all review x 8 aspect cells
loss.sentiment: CrossEntropy over gold-present core aspect cells only; sum / number of such cells in batch; zero if none

preprocessing.length_choice_rule: 128 if train P99<=128 and train truncation@128<=1%; otherwise 256
preprocessing.padding: dynamic right padding to batch maximum capped at max_length

segmentation.bridge: src/VnCoreNLPBatch.java; join segmented sentences by one space; each review independent

preprocessing.truncation: right; add BOS and EOS; preserve EOS when truncating

phobert.scheduler: linear warmup for first 10% optimizer steps, then linear decay

estimator.multiclass: OneVsRestClassifier; conditional probabilities normalized over 3 classes

tfidf_logistic.heads: 8 independent binary aspect classifiers; 7 gold-present sentiment OVR classifiers; shared train-fitted features
tfidf_logistic.preprocessing: common NFC/whitespace then vectorizer lowercase=True; no word segmentation

metrics: unchanged frozen evaluator v1; support ceilings are interpretation only, not a normalized new metric

determinism.shuffle: train only, generator seeded per registered seed

runtime.exact_GPU_reproducibility: must be measured on target hardware; package hashes alone do not guarantee bitwise CUDA determinism

modeling.training_packages_status: torch/sklearn dependency graph resolved and hash-locked; full GPU runtime not installed or executed in this preflight

runtime.neural_hardware_required: single CUDA GPU with >=16 GiB; record GPU/driver/CUDA and actual package versions at launch; CPU is only for diagnostics, not silent replacement of the registered GPU budget

selection.candidate_tie_break: higher mean val joint micro-F1, then lexicographically lower preregistered candidate id
selection.checkpoint_selection: after each epoch on val using selected global threshold; best primary, then micro, then earliest epoch
selection.early_stopping: patience on no primary improvement; min_delta=0.0; never test-based
selection.missing_validation_class: PRICE-negative not individually tunable; no class-specific thresholds or test compensation
selection.primary: mean official val joint.macro_f1 across all 3 registered seeds
selection.sentiment_decoding: argmax over positive, neutral, negative; ties follow this fixed order
selection.test: one final evaluation round per preregistered selected family/checkpoints/all seeds, only after full run manifests; original + frozen diagnostic subsets
selection.threshold_application: one global threshold over all 8 aspect probabilities per trained checkpoint; sigmoid for neural; binary probability for LR
selection.threshold_tie_break: higher val joint micro-F1; then closest to 0.5; then smaller threshold

sensitivity_tracks: evaluation subsets already frozen; training-without-NAN and weighting/focal require a separate preregistered extension before fitting

target_order.joint_decoding: predicted aspect gate plus exactly one conditional sentiment per present core aspect; no OTHERS joint pair

text_policy.common: src/modeling_preflight.py::prepare_text: NFC + collapse Unicode whitespace; retain case, accents, punctuation, emoji and negation

training_launch_gates: new trainer implementation and exact code/dirty hash recorded
target hardware and training dependencies verified
